question: Which deity must be contemplated after moving awareness to the svādhiṣṭhāna center?
premises: The practitioner moves to the svādhiṣṭhāna
The chosen deity is the object of contemplation
inference: After reaching the svādhiṣṭhāna, one should contemplate the chosen deity.
plain_english: Then, having gone to the svādhiṣṭhāna, one should contemplate the chosen deity.
